title: Read balance, equity and margin
summary: Find your [[balance]], [[equity]], [[margin]], [[free-margin|free margin]] and [[margin-level|margin level]] in the Trade tab, and watch them change with one small demo trade.

steps.text: Check you are on your demo account before you start.
Open the Trade tab. With no trades open, write down the balance, equity, margin and free margin. Margin level may be blank when nothing is open.
Go to the Quotes tab, tap EUR/USD and choose the option to trade.

On the order screen, set the volume to 0.01 and place a market buy. Leaving stop loss and take profit empty is for this short check only: you will close the trade a moment later. In your own practice, always set a stop loss.
Go back to the Trade tab. Write down the balance, equity, margin, free margin and margin level again.
Check: equity minus margin should equal free margin, and equity ÷ margin × 100 should match the margin level, allowing for prices moving while you read.
Tap or press and hold the open position (it depends on your app version), then choose the option to close it.
Read the balance once more. It now includes the result of the closed trade.

afterQuestions.prompt: While the trade was open, which number changed with every price tick?

options.explanation: Right: equity includes the open profit or loss, so it moves with price.
No: the balance only changes when a trade is closed or a charge is applied.

afterQuestions.prompt: What happened to free margin when you opened the trade?

options.explanation: No: opening a trade ties up margin, so less is free.

options.text: It went down by about the margin the trade used
options.explanation: Right: free margin = equity − used margin, so opening a trade reduces it.
